# Cncf Azure Functions Reviewer

Review Azure Functions using its official documentation and repository in the Serverless / Hosted Platform category. Develop more efficiently with Functions, an event-driven serverless compute platform that can also solve complex orchestration problems. Build and debug locally without additional setup, deploy and operate at scale in the cloud, and integrate services using triggers and bindings.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
